item.text:
Reconstructed the four Punjabi verses in Shahmukhi and moved the original Roman wording into `romanLyrics`, normalizing capitalization and end punctuation. Verified that both versions contain one stanza of four verses in the same order.

Updated the title and script metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag. I read the ambiguous “Mula Haza” as `ملاحظہ` and “bait” as `بیعت`.
